cohort: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and a singleton gestation delivering at term (37-40 weeks)
finding: Induction of labor in GDM mothers at term did not reduce the cesarean section rate and may be associated with an increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes, particularly when performed before 39 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: Induction of labor in mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus at term was not found to reduce the cesarean section rate.
